model_requirement: Record requested alias and returned model ID; do not claim immutable version
budget_enforcement: Conservative per-request UTF-8 bytes plus 4096 framing reservation; max_tokens capped by remaining reservation; cumulative API total_tokens checked; may stop substantially below 32000. Not calibrated exact tokenizer accounting.
mounts: only problem.md and baseline repo; never workspace root, Docker socket, credentials, hidden tests, source snapshots or after evidence
cost_rule: provider usage times recorded price version; unavailable pricing remains null
credential_source: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (environment or project .env; never copied into agent container)
regression_scope: bundled hidden assertions only; full upstream regressions not run
